_help: Spells. 'classes' = which class spell lists include it. Damage and healing make the Cast button roll for you: 'atSlot' maps slot level -> dice (listing only the base level is fine if the higher-level text says 'increases by XdY for each slot level above N'), 'atCharLevel' is for cantrips that grow at character levels 5/11/17. In healing, MOD means + spellcasting modifier.

spells._help: Damage spell with an attack roll and upcasting.
spells.name: Ember Lance
spells.description: Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Fire damage.
spells.higherLevel: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.

spells._help: Cantrip with a saving throw; damage by character level.
spells.name: Frost Snap
spells.description: A creature makes a Constitution saving throw or takes 1d8 Cold damage and its Speed drops by 10 feet until your next turn.

spells._help: Healing spell (every slot level written out).
spells.name: Mending Light
spells.description: A creature you can see regains Hit Points equal to 1d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

spells._help: Concentration spell with a material component and no dice: casting it starts tracking concentration.
spells.name: Warding Chime
spells.description: A soft chime surrounds you. Allies within 10 feet have Advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition.
